children: Philip D. Eigenmann, an officer serving as Chief Accounting Officer, reported a sale of Match Group common stock. The filing reports a weighted average selling price of $41.6999 per share. The total reported sale amount was $625,498 for 15,000 shares disposed. Following the transaction, Eigenmann directly owns 19,389 shares of Match Group common stock.
